fact: La Nation reports that on 18 December 2024 the head of a public primary school in Cotonou was entering the personal details of her CI pupils on Educmaster, the other pupils and the staff being already registered, and describes the school's role as enrolling and registering every learner; it says the platform was set up by the secondary ministry (MESTFP), that all public and private collèges and lycées must enter enrolments, transfers and absences on it, and that the ministry's director of information systems said only end-of-semester averages had been loaded until then, the coming version to take the marks themselves.
title: Plateforme «Educmaster»: La révolution numérique au service de l'Ecole
